ideas.summary: Believers should not fear death since there is no set time and going to heaven should bring joy, not fear.
Living is abused when death is feared; fear of death is the devil's old strategy.
Death as gain must become one's lived reality, not merely an intellectual idea.
Fear of death observed even among believers reveals it is not yet fully embraced as gain.
ideas.human_review: Lexical overlap is low because the model stayed close to SRC007115-118 rather than the SourceMap summary. Meaning is clearly represented.

ideas.summary: If a believer does not practice Christ as life, facing death becomes heavy and difficult.
Some believers foreknow the exact hour of their death and depart peacefully.
